text:
Alex Chen: FYI Mosaic legal pushed a final set of questions and wants the compatibility POC start confirmed for Wed. They care about API surface parity, response deltas, and security gating. @Maria can you drive POC owners?
Maria Gomez: I got it. I'll own prompt parity tests and sweep for response diffs. Need someone for runtime behavior and one for security answers.
Tyler Patel: I can take runtime behavior (mapping routes + rate limits). Quick q — Mosaic uses a query param `model=fast-32` and expects chunked streaming. We should confirm streaming + model-mapping.
Sophie Li: I'll handle security Qs. Send the questionnaire. main asks: encryption in transit at TLS1.3, KMS for keys, and audit logs retention. I can answer but need exact infra notes.
Ethan Brooks: On pricing — Mosaic expects near-cost parity for token pricing during the POC. Can we offer committed burst credits on Hosted for the trial? If yes, what's the per-token cap?
Alex Chen: @Ethan propose a capped trial credit of $10k with usage alerts and auto-throttle at 5 RPS per org. That keeps costs bounded.
Tyler Patel: For streaming parity: Redwood supports chunked SSE/HTTP2 streaming and we can emulate the competitor's event envelopes. I'll prototype a small compatibility proxy that rewrites event headers and model names. Example sketch:
```bash
# simple proxy mapping
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.test/generate -d '{"model":"mosaic-32"}' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
# proxy maps to redwood model `rwd-fast-32` and streams same envelope
```
Maria Gomez: Nice. For prompt parity, I'll run their canonical prompts through both endpoints and diff tokens + completions. Need a small harness. Any objections to using a synthetic 20k prompt set?
Sophie Li: No objections. Also add a test for PII redaction differences — Mosaic flagged data retention concerns. We should state logs retention policy and optional customer-managed logging.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire link: https://redwood-internal/poqs/mosaic-2026 - status: unfilled.
Ethan Brooks: Confirming pricing: we can mark the trial at $0.01 per 1k tokens for the duration of POC until credit exhausted. Will that satisfy their procurement?
Alex Chen: Sounds reasonable. Flag for Sales Ops — prepare a simple MSA addendum for trial credits. @Maria create the runbook for tests and expected acceptance criteria.
Maria Gomez: Will do. Acceptance criteria draft: 1) identical top-1 completion for 85% of canonical prompts 2) average tail-latency < 180ms for 512-token workloads 3) streaming envelope parity verified 4) security questionnaire answered and SOC2 carve-outs documented.
Tyler Patel: Adding infra checks: 1) model name mapping table + fallback rules 2) rate limit equivalence (burst, sustained) 3) response normalization rules for timestamp/ids 4) headers mapping for tracing (x-request-id -> x-mosaic-trace).
Sophie Li: I'll populate the security answers. For customer-managed keys we need to confirm KMS integrations for Private deployments; note: on-hosted we can offer bring-your-own-key via our KMS bridge (doc link: https://redwood-docs/ky).
Ethan Brooks: I'll draft the trial pricing email and the usage alert thresholds. Also adding a line item for Dedicated trial pricing if they want predictable latency during POC.
Alex Chen: Who can run the first smoke tomorrow afternoon? Need a working proxy + one sample prompt comparison.
Tyler Patel: I can do the smoke at 3pm PT. I'll push a quick proxy container to `staging-eval` and share curl examples.
Maria Gomez: I'll run the diff harness after Tyler posts results.
Sophie Li: I uploaded initial answers to sec-bot link. Left a couple of TODOs for infra team clarifications.
sec-bot: Updated questionnaire status: 3/27 answered, 2 TODOs assigned to Sophie Li and Eng Infra.
Alex Chen: Great. Follow-ups: - Tyler: share proxy image + run commands - Maria: run initial 2k prompt batch and share metrics - Ethan: finalize trial credit terms - Sophie: finish remaining security items by EOD Tue.
Maria Gomez: Copy. I'll post a short doc with test harness and expected json diffs. Link incoming. :thumbsup:
Tyler Patel: Putting initial proxy image at: registry.redwood/staging/mosaic-proxy:v0.1.
Ethan Brooks: I'll escalate pricing term to Sales Ops.
Sophie Li: Will close security TODOs and ping infra for KMS specifics.
Alex Chen: Thanks team. If Mosaic legal signs the trial addendum we'll kick off Wed. Ping here with any blockers.
Maria Gomez: Quick note — if we hit >15% content delta on top-1 completions, escalate to product for tuning; might require model prompt templates.
Tyler Patel: Noted. I'll also add a response-normalization layer to mask minor formatting diffs (whitespace, trailing punctuation) so acceptance focuses on semantic equivalence.
Alex Chen: Perfect. Closing out for now.
note: thread is a sales presales coordination thread for a compatibility POC with a competitor's API — includes owners, quick code sketch, security questionnaire link, and acceptance criteria
